description: Golden set for the X reply guard (own-status-page replies). Tiers: 'bad-faith' (expected blurred — hostile/bot/spam), 'tempting-bad-faith' (harsh, skeptical, accusatory or mocking but ON-TOPIC — expected SHOWN; hiding any of these is the echo-chamber failure mode), 'genuine' (expected shown). Seeded from the real replies to Kuan's 2026-07-22 Network School post; grow it from the durable log's surface:'own-replies' events + peek events (a peeked-and-read blurred reply is a false-positive candidate).
